verdicts.title: Toric Generalized Kähler-Ricci Solitons with Hamiltonian 2-form
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show that the generalized Kähler-Ricci soliton equation on 4-dimensional toric Kähler orbifolds reduces to ODEs assuming there is a Hamiltonian 2-form. This leads to an explicit resolution of this equation on labeled triangles and convex labeled quadrilaterals. In particular, we give the explicit expression of the Kähler-Ricci solitons of weighted projective planes as well as new examples.
